result.brief: 提出 Refrain 统一多镜头视频生成模型，通过自监督重建学习跨镜头一致性，支持任意参考与任意时长，并给出 Shot-Debiased Consistency 评测指标。
result.reason: Multi-shot video generation with unified reference-to-timeline mapping and a self-supervised reconstruction objective; also proposes a consistency metric for video generation evaluation.
